mapper.update: UPDATE provider_channel SET status = #{status}, supports_idempotent_submit = #{idempotentSubmit}, supports_query_by_attempt = #{queryByAttempt}, supports_cancel = #{cancel} WHERE code = #{code} AND kind = 'HTTP'
UPDATE provider_channel SET queued = queued + 1 WHERE code = #{code} AND queued < queue_capacity
UPDATE provider_channel SET queued = queued - 1 WHERE id = #{channelId} AND queued > 0
UPDATE provider_channel SET in_flight = in_flight + 1, queued = queued - 1 WHERE id = #{channelId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND in_flight < max_in_flight AND queued > 0
UPDATE provider_channel SET in_flight = in_flight - 1 WHERE id = #{channelId} AND in_flight > 0
UPDATE provider_channel SET in_flight = in_flight - 1, queued = queued + 1 WHERE id = #{channelId} AND in_flight > 0
